subLocations.name: The Smilin' Boar
subLocations.lore: One of Bloomridge's most trendy eateries, serving bawdier versions of traditional morningfeast dishes such as "[[sow's delight]]" and "[[three pigs in a blanket]]", and [[coffee]] and [[tea]] was served in mugs that were shaped like a [[pig]]'s head.

subLocations.name: Blushing Mermaid
subLocations.lore: A famous lower-class tavern that provided drinks and food and was known for its shady associations, rumors of secret smuggling passages, and hidden vaults underneath.

subLocations.name: Elfsong Tavern
subLocations.lore: A well-known tavern famed for its singing [[ghost]], [[Elfsong Cider|cider]], and a stuffed baby [[beholder]].

subLocations.name: Low Lantern
subLocations.lore: A three-mast ship converted to be used as a [[festhall]], tavern, and gambling house.

subLocations.name: Jopalin's
subLocations.lore: Once a seedy tavern serving sailors, turned into a [[tea]] and [[coffee]]-sipping cafe after such establishments became popular in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

subLocations.name: Garmult's House of Mastery
subLocations.lore: An academy that specialized in tutoring pupils on how to improve their martial prowess and combat skills and a social club for the members of the [[Bannerless Legion]] crew.

subLocations.name: Undercellar's Main Entrance
subLocations.lore: A clump of chambers in a network of storage cellars beneath [[Baldur's Gate]] that housed a sleazy tavern and [[festhall]]; there existed at least twenty-four ways in and out of this popular establishment, half of which connected to other buildings.

subLocations.name: House of the Lute
subLocations.lore: A modest [[kaeth]] house and [[minstrel]]s' gallery that offered classes from master musicians to its customers.

subLocations.name: The House of the Lion
subLocations.lore: An opulent festhall that counted "blades" and "lacethroats"  – youths of money and means, among its patrons.

subLocations.name: The Singing Lute
subLocations.lore: A small tavern and an eatery that offered local brews and a grumpy proprietor.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Sharess' Caress
subLocations.lore: A 15{{th}} century [[DR]] [[festhall]] where one could find consorts, musicians, drinks, food, lodgings, and more thematic coinlassess who catered to specific tastes.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: The Glitter Gala
subLocations.lore: A shop that traded in [[gemstone]]s and jewelry from [[Amn]], [[Cormyr]], and [[Damara]] and shared the building with [[Chromatic Scale]] musical instrument shop.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Chromatic Scale
subLocations.lore: A shop that dealt in quality musical instruments, run by [[Thomas C. Quirkilious]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Facemaker's Boutique
subLocations.lore: An upscale clothier, barber, makeup artist, stylist, and disguises shop.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Crimson Draughts
subLocations.lore: [[Araj Oblodra]]'s [[alchemist]] shop located on [[Stormshore Street]] across from [[Beehive Goods and Wares]] general store in the late 15{{th}} century DR.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Beehive Goods and Wares
subLocations.lore: A general store run by [[Oliver Tefoco]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]] and offered food, [[potion]]s, [[wine]]s, and some general miscellany.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Sword Coast Couriers
subLocations.lore: A courier, shipping, and postal agency that operated in the environs and within the city of [[Baldur's Gate]], located in the [[Rivington]] neighborhood in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

subLocations.name: Helm and Cloak
subLocations.lore: A high-end inn, rooming house, and [[festhall]], popular both with travelers and with local residents, who enjoyed its resplendent dining room. It was also home to the majority of the [[Knights of the Unicorn]], who rented most of the upper floor.

subLocations.name: Three Old Kegs
subLocations.lore: A well-known inn widely regarded as one of the best establishments in all of [[Faerûn]], and was known for its comfortable furnishings and generally somnific atmosphere.

subLocations.name: Blade and Stars
subLocations.lore: A quiet inn known for its high-quality foodstuffs, and a legend of a [[yuan-ti]] being trapped within the inn's walls, imprisoned while fighting a [[wizard]].

subLocations.name: Drakon Tavern
subLocations.lore: A relatively small inn and tavern located next door to the [[Gist]] family estate with a small park plaza at the building's back.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Keexie Tavern
subLocations.lore: A simple tavern and inn that served as a front for [[Baldur's Gate]]'s thieves guild in the 14{{th}} century [[DR]], located across the plaza from [[Sorcerous Sundries]].{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Rivington General
subLocations.lore: A smithy that dealt in [[weapon]]s and [[armor]], run by [[Gyldro Angleiron]] after [[1477 DR]]. Its shop area was a building to the north, with the southern connected structure being the workshop and the proprietor's home.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Bonecloak's Apothecary
subLocations.lore: A [[potion]] brewer's shop run by [[Derryth Bonecloak]] and [[Baelen Bonecloak]] ''circa'' [[1492 DR]].{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Harbreeze Bakery
subLocations.lore: A bakery offered such favorite delicacies as [[cinnamon]] [[cookie]]s and full loaves of [[sugarbread]] highlighted by the flavors of foreign [[tea]]s and [[spice]]s.

subLocations.name: Felogyr's Fireworks
subLocations.lore: A four-story stone shop on [[Bindle Street]] that traded in [[fireworks]], [[torch]]es, [[candle]] wicks, and other lesser alchemical items, and as of the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]], the sole producer of [[smokepowder]] within [[Baldur's Gate]].

subLocations.name: Counting House
subLocations.lore: The center of trade and business in [[Baldur's Gate]], serving as both a bank and establishment that facilitated the exchange of various currencies.

subLocations.name: Sorcerous Sundries
subLocations.lore: A magic shop on [[Stormshore Street]] in the [[Heapside]] district.

subLocations.name: Eastway Expeditions
subLocations.lore: A shop that specialized in selling equipment to those who sought exploration or adventure, particularly those ''en route'' to the [[Chultan Peninsula]].

subLocations.name: Candulhallow's Funeral Arrangements
subLocations.lore: A city-sponsored business that specialized in the transportation and occasionally sale of corpses to cemeteries or temples.

subLocations.name: Candlekeep Chandlery
subLocations.lore: A shop that sold beautifying products and [[candle]]s, both mundane and magical in nature.

subLocations.name: Lucky Aello's Discount Store
subLocations.lore: A store that sold heavily marked-down goods that ranged from [[potion]]s of reliable quality to ''[[curse]]d'' [[weapon]]s and [[scroll]]s of magic protection.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Maltz's Weapon Shop
subLocations.lore: A merchant who dealt in mandate weapons, ran by [[Maltz]] in the 14{{th}} century [[DR]], located just to the northwest of the [[Elfsong Tavern]].{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Well-Adjusted Al's General Store
subLocations.lore: The general store located to the west of the [[Low Lantern]]; it traded in mundane goods and [[weapon]]s and run by eccentric [[Well-Adjusted Al]] in the 14{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Alabaster Stonecrafts
subLocations.lore: An open-air stonemason's workshop run by twin [[dwarf|dwarven]] siblings in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Danthelon's Dancing Axe
subLocations.lore: A general store that sold good quality secondhand wares, from pots and pans to [[rope]], [[armor]], and [[weapons]].

subLocations.name: Hamhocks Slaughterhouse
subLocations.lore: A massive compound composed of a number of animal pens, knackeries, and butcheries, its foul stench drove away the animals of the herders and wranglers.

subLocations.name: Garynmor Stables and Menagerie
subLocations.lore: A business that specialized in the handling and care of mundane beasts of burden, as well as the exhibition of all manner of exotic and fantastical creatures.
